[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips to boost motivation to exercise regularly:

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Make it convenient: Incorporate physical activity into your daily routine.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Vary your routine: Mix up your exercise routine to avoid boredom.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Track your progress: Use a fitness tracker, journal, or mobile app.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Get accountability: Exercise with a friend or personal trainer.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Reward yourself: Set small rewards for reaching exercise milestones.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Focus on how you feel: Remember the benefits of exercise beyond appearance.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Be kind to yourself: Don't be too hard on yourself if you miss a day.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To avoid disrupting sleep schedule:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Exercise at the right time: Avoid vigorous exercise within 2-3 hours of bedtime.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Choose morning exercise: Exercising in the morning can help regulate circadian rhythms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Listen to your body: Adjust your exercise routine if feeling tired or experiencing insomnia.
